jcr_content.jcr:title: TQMT1042 Embedded Power Architecture® module
jcr_content.jcr:description: The TQMT1042 embedded module embodies the next generation of the well-known TQMP1020/2020 QorIQ® product family. The QorIQ® T1 processor family inaugurates new applications in industry and communications. With four e5500 (64-bit) cores and a clock rate of up to 4x 1400 MHz, the TQ modules using QorIQ® processors provide the best ratio between processing speed and power loss. The 28 nm technology significantly reduces the power consumption compared to a QorIQ® module of the former generation. This feature, together with the expanded temperature range and intelligent power management, enables the use in fan-free systems. The TQMT1042 is best suited for industrial applications that demand high availability, outdoor ambient temperatures and small overall size.

textwithimage.text:
Quad-Core Power Architecture® module with high I/O connectivity and processing power with low power consumption

The TQMT1042 embedded module embodies the next generation of the well-known TQMP1020/2020 QorIQ® product family. The QorIQ® T1 processor family inaugurates new applications in industry and communications. With four e5500 (64-bit) cores and a clock rate of up to 4x 1400 MHz, the TQ modules using QorIQ® processors provide the best ratio between processing speed and power loss. The 28 nm technology significantly reduces the power consumption compared to a QorIQ® module of the former generation. This feature, together with the expanded temperature range and intelligent power management, enables the use in fan-free systems. The TQMT1042 is best suited for industrial applications that demand high availability, outdoor ambient temperatures and small overall size.

text.text:
Features

  • Quad T1042 Power Architecture®
  • High-speed communication via 5x Gigabit Ethernet, 4x PCle and two USB 2.0 High-speed interfaces
  • Dual SATA interfaces for data storage
  • Quad-core up to 1400 MHz in 28nm SOI for best performance/watt ratio
  • Display interface Unit
  • Simple functional expansion via PCle, eSPI, I²C and IFC (Local Bus)

table_spec.text:
CPU

CPU/Processor:

  • Quad T1042 Power Architecture® e5500 cores (64-bit)
  • CPU JTAG interface
Memory

EEPROM:

  • 32kbit

eMMC:

  • Up to 8 GB (optional)

NOR Flash:

  • Up to 256 MB

DDR3L:

  • Up to 8 GB
Graphics

Graphic interface:

  • Display controller for TFT LCD displays (up to 24-bit RGB)
Communication interfaces

Serial Ports:

  • DUART, max. 115 kBaud (RS232)

Ethernet:

  • 5x Gbit Ethernet (with IEEE® 1588v2)

USB:

  • 2x USB 2.0 High Speed Host/Device/OTG
Other interfaces

GPIO:

  • Up to 32x GPIO

SPI:

  • 1x eSPI Controller

I2C:

  • 4x I²C, max. 400 kHz

SATA:

  • 2x SATA 2.0

PCIe:

  • 4x PCle, 2.0 Controller up to 5.0 Gbit/s according to PCI Express specification 2.0 as Root-Complex or Endpoint
General

Dimensions:

  • 74 mm x 54 mm

Temperature range:

  • Standard temperature: 0°C - +70°C
  • Extended temperature: -40°C - +85°C

Power supply:

  • 5 V

Plug-in System:

  • Board-to-Board plug-in system 360 pins

Power consumption:

  • typ. 5 W up to 7 W

General:

  • Simple expansion for example via MMC/SDHC, USB
  • Real-Time Debug Interface (Aurora)
  • 1x Integrated Flash Controller (IFC), 16-bit
  • 2x TDM (via QUICC Engine)
OS

OS Support:

  • Linux
  • PikeOS™ (on request)

table.text:
TQMT1040-BA

TQ Minimodule with T1040 Quad Core CPU with up to 4x 1200 MHz, Crypto, 2 GB DDR3 SDRAM, 128 MB NOR flash, 32 KB EEPROM, -40°C - +85°C
STKT1040-SET-BA

Starter kit with TQ Minimodule TQMT1040-Band baseboard STKT104X, Power Supply, Z-Modem cable, module extractor, heat spreader and documentation
Baseboard STKT104X

The baseboard STKT104X supports all modules of the type series TQMT104x and represents an universal platform for evaluation and development of customer specific platforms for those modules
Other configurations on request

text.text:
